name: spooky-bench
description:
SpookyBench: A Benchmark for Purely Temporal Video Understanding
	

SpookyBench is a novel benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the ability of video-language models (VLMs) to understand purely temporal patterns, independent of spatial cues. The dataset consists of 451 videos across four categories: Text, Object Images, Dynamic Scenes, and Shapes. reputation: A novel, niche benchmark for temporal-only video understanding (temporal blindness) with interest from researchers studying VLM temporal reasoning but limited broad adoption so far.
